description: Search and selection of multiple options, showing and removing the choices.

howToUse: Use it to pick several options from a long list: tags, people, cities.
Each choice becomes a chip in the field, with its own remove button. Limit how many show with `maxVisibleChips`; the rest becomes a "+N" count.
Use `listPlacement="overlay"` when the list must not push the content below.
Set `emptyMessage` to say what to do when nothing matches.
alternatives: Up to about six options that fit on screen: Checkbox list or ToggleGroup.

keyboard.action: Opens the list and moves between options.
With the list open, goes to the first or last option.
Selects or clears the highlighted option.
With the search empty, removes the last choice.

props.description: Fired on each change with the full list of values.

props.name: maxVisibleChips
props.description: Optional chip cap; the available space may reduce this number.

props.name: listPlacement
props.description: Inline expands the field; overlay sits over the content without shifting the layout.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Message when no option matches the search.
